body:
Client UUID (that you were banned on): YourAsian

Type of Punishment (if ban, name how long the ban is): Perm ban

Reasoning to why your ban should be appealed: I was banned for ban evading, when my brother (Camemes) unbanned me from teamspeak because he belived I had waited the correct amount of time  to  be unbanned, I got unbanned, I log onto teamspeak and then shadowwolf bans me again!! I am kranky!!!! I got falsely banned!!!! AGAIN!!!!! please unban me because I did not do anything wrong, Camemes unbanned me from ts then I got rebanned!! UNBAN ME!!!!!!!

title: Ban Appeal - YourAsian

replies.author: shadowolfyt
replies.body:
Hello {tag=cda1173ee6384506ac1e49bc334a754f},
I banned you because you were indeed 'Ban Evading'. Your brother unbanned you so that he doesn't get banned either (because you are both on the same network) he didn't unban you because he belived that you had waited the correct amount of time because that's untrue. I spoke to Cammy about this yesterday and that's why you are banned.
You were not falsely banned and you will not be unbanned. Your appeal has been denied.

Have a nice day :)
- {tag=0af038412894434ca4be965b317244e8}

Regards,
